==Description==
The '''Santa's Air Strike''' is one of two rare consumables that are only obtainable via a [[Holiday Crate]] with a 16.67% chance, or through match rewards. However, the [[Holiday Crate]]s cannot be obtained anymore, they can only be opened.

Only up to three '''Santa Air Strike's''' can be used in a match by a single player. It has a 30 second cooldown, with its initial cooldown also being set to 30 seconds.

==Usage==
When using the '''Santa's Air Strike''', your avatar's right hand will hold a radio with a white and red pattern, playing a custom idle animation. You will be able to choose an area where the '''Santa's Air Strike''' will fire bombs at. These bombs will create an ice puddle, which reduces defense and chills enemies that walk over it. This wall of ice lasts for 15 seconds, chilling any enemy that walks past it by 35% for 3 seconds and dropping its defense by 20%. It can drop up to 33% of an enemy's defense and the freezing effect can stack with other freezing towers.

==Appearance==
The '''Santa's Air Strike''' is a red sleigh, that drops different colored presents.

==Strategy==
*Due to it being a consumable that chills enemies, enemies with the [[Freeze Immunity]] attribute will be immune to it.
*While it can be good to use with other freezing towers, such as the [[Cryomancer]], it does do a worse job than it. 
**Therefore, if a player has brought a good freezing tower, it would be advised not to bring this consumable, as it is a waste of a slot.
*Note that, unlike its [[Napalm Strike|moderately heat-intensive counterpart]], the '''Santa's Air Strike''' cannot deal damage.

==Trivia==
*It acts as a counterpart to the [[Napalm Strike]] consumable, in which instead of dealing burn damage, it chills enemies.
**It also uses the same voice line for its usage, though for the '''Santa's Air Strike''' it actually makes little sense to play, since it the audio refers to it as a "''fire strike team''".
